frontend_prompt.description: As a frontend developer, create a React application with the necessary components and functionality for the TODO web application.
tasks: Design and implement the user interface for the task list, including a form for adding new tasks and buttons for editing and deleting existing tasks.
Integrate a library or component for user authentication (e.g. React Auth, React Context API) and connect it to the backend REST endpoints.
Implement the logic for rendering the task list, including fetching data from the backend and updating the list when tasks are added, edited, or deleted.
Add input validation for user inputs in the form, such as task name and description.
Implement basic error handling for cases like network errors, invalid API responses, and authentication errors.
deliverables: A fully functional React application with a task list component, add/edit/delete form, and user authentication
Implementation of validation and error handling for user inputs and API responses

backend_prompt.description: As a backend developer, design and implement the FastAPI application with REST endpoints for task management and user authentication.
tasks: Design and implement a set of REST endpoints for CRUD operations on tasks, including GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE
Implement user authentication and authorization using FastAPI's built-in support for authentication and authorization
Use a library like Pydantic for data validation and validation of user inputs
Implement basic error handling for API requests, including validation and authentication errors
Setup and configure PostgreSQL database connections and queries for CRUD operations
deliverables: A fully functional FastAPI application with REST endpoints for task management and user authentication
Implementation of validation and error handling for API requests and database queries

database_prompt.description: As a database developer, design and implement the PostgreSQL database schema for the TODO web application.
tasks: Design the database schema for tasks, including tables for tasks, users, and task lists
Create indexes on relevant columns for efficient query performance
Implement relationships between tables using foreign keys
Setup and configure PostgreSQL database user accounts and permissions for the backend application
Test and verify that the database schema is correctly implemented and functional
deliverables: A fully functional PostgreSQL database schema for tasks, users, and task lists
Setup and configuration of PostgreSQL database user accounts and permissions
